snippet.title: Feed the Scorchpot | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Feed the Scorchpot is a cozy-chaotic tabletop roguelike about dice, meals, and mild panic. Build your board, harvest what you can, and serve up dishes fast enough to stop your dragon from burning the whole economy down.

———
